title: Design System: NeoRealm LAB Graphite Cinema

display.purpose: English hero and major cinematic statements.

label.purpose: Captions, indices, evidence labels, and metadata.

shadows.name: release-float
shadows.purpose: Separates the flowing media cards from Graphite Surface.

shadows.name: studio-vignette
shadows.purpose: Contains the active abstract Studio image.

motion.name: material-reveal
motion.purpose: Settles Studio transitions and clipped pointer trails without delaying feedback.

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Studio step and KV message visibility changes.

motion.name: text-crop
motion.purpose: Moves customer-facing copy through directional clip-path entrances and faster inverse exits; body copy may follow its heading by no more than 90ms.

motion.name: poster-fade
motion.purpose: Crossfades the KV poster only after video passes 6.2 seconds.

motion.name: inquiry-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveals the full-viewport inquiry shell with an upward clip-path and restrained settlement.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses transitions and removes video, parallax, drift, and ghost transforms.

components.name: Primary Project Action
components.description: Acid Signal action for selected work and project inquiry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid #d9f45f; border-radius:0; background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; font-family:Marcellus,serif; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#f2f1eb; border-color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Project Action
components.description: Projection White outline action used over cinematic media.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:48px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid #f2f1eb; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#f2f1eb; font-family:Marcellus,serif; font-size:13px; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f2f1eb; color:#11110f; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.description: Fixed Silk Veil navigation with the white SVG wordmark, Marcellus routes, and Acid Signal action.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { position:fixed; inset:0 0 auto; z-index:18; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; min-height:72px; padding:10px 4vw; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16); background:rgba(12,13,12,.22); backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(128%); color:#f2f1eb; font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-nav div { display:flex; gap:32px; } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; font-size:12px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-action { justify-self:end; padding:10px 14px; border:1px solid #d9f45f; color:#d9f45f!important; }

components.name: Sticky KV Sequence
components.description: A 178dvh video and poster stage with a two-message scroll sequence.
components.html:
I DESIGN

components.css: .ds-kv { position:relative; display:flex; min-height:560px; align-items:center; padding:6vw; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,9,8,.9),rgba(8,9,8,.2)),#080908; color:#f2f1eb; font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-kv p { margin:0; font-size:clamp(58px,7vw,96px); line-height:.92; } .ds-kv span { position:absolute; right:6vw; bottom:8vh; color:#d9f45f; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Studio Story
components.description: Half-width sticky abstract image paired with a scrolling editorial chapter.
components.html:
01 / 03

I design new realms.

品牌、網站、AI 影像與動態敘事交會的獨立創意工作室。
components.css: .ds-studio { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:8vw; padding:6vw; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-studio-image { position:relative; min-height:520px; border:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.12); background:#20211e; } .ds-studio-image span { position:absolute; right:16px; bottom:16px; padding:7px 9px; background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; font-family:Marcellus,serif; } .ds-studio article { align-self:center; } .ds-studio h2 { font:400 clamp(48px,6vw,88px)/.95 Marcellus,serif; } .ds-studio p { max-width:34ch; color:#b0aea5; font:400 17px/1.9 'Zen Old Mincho',serif; }

components.name: Perspective Salon Gallery
components.description: Sticky narrative beside three asymmetric far, middle, and near exhibit lanes; twelve curated 4:5 plates preserve their full canvas while bounded scale, vertical and lateral parallax create depth.
components.html: Worlds in motion.
components.css: .ds-waterfall { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.54fr 1.46fr; background:#1b1b18; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-waterfall header { position:sticky; top:20vh; align-self:start; padding:15vh 6vw; } .ds-streams { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.12fr .78fr; gap:1.8vw; padding:18vh 3vw 20vh 0; } .ds-streams div { min-height:1200px; background:#11110f; } .ds-streams .far { transform:scale(.82); opacity:.68; } .ds-streams .near { transform:scale(1.08); } .ds-streams .mid { transform:scale(.93); opacity:.9; }

components.name: Low-Chroma Instagram Rail
components.description: One explicitly scrollable row of all twenty supplied 4:5 Instagram works; images remain uncropped, lazy-load, and restore original color on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-instagram { overflow:hidden; padding:10vw 0; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-instagram div { display:grid; width:max-content; grid-auto-columns:clamp(180px,18vw,292px); grid-auto-flow:column; gap:1vw; overflow-x:auto; scroll-snap-type:x proximity; } .ds-instagram a { aspect-ratio:4/5; scroll-snap-align:start; filter:grayscale(1) saturate(.1); opacity:.7; transition:filter 360ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity 240ms ease; } .ds-instagram img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; } .ds-instagram a:hover,.ds-instagram a:focus-visible { filter:none; opacity:1; }

components.name: Image Trail Card
components.description: Flowing media card with bounded scroll depth and clipped fine-pointer image trails.
components.css: .ds-release { position:relative; min-height:420px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:0; background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.24); } .ds-release div { position:absolute; inset:0; background:#20211e; } .ds-release h3,.ds-release p { position:absolute; left:28px; z-index:1; } .ds-release h3 { bottom:52px; margin:0; font:400 34px/1 Marcellus,serif; } .ds-release p { bottom:24px; margin:0; color:#b0aea5; font:400 13px/1.5 'Zen Old Mincho',serif; } .ds-release:focus-within { outline:2px solid #f2f1eb; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Project Inquiry Dialog
components.description: Full-viewport native dialog with a fixed dark header and a reduced-motion-safe clip-path reveal; Escape, close and backdrop interactions return focus to the opener.
components.html: NeoRealm LAB
components.css: .ds-inquiry { inset:0; width:100vw; max-width:none; height:100dvh; max-height:none; margin:0; padding:0; overflow:hidden; border:0; background:transparent; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-inquiry::backdrop { background:rgba(5,6,5,.86); backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(78%); } .ds-inquiry-shell { width:100%; height:100%; overflow:hidden; background:#11110f; clip-path:inset(100% 0 0); transform:translate3d(0,36px,0); transition:clip-path 760ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 760ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-inquiry[open] .ds-inquiry-shell { clip-path:inset(0); transform:none; } .ds-inquiry header { position:absolute; inset:0 0 auto; z-index:6; display:flex; min-height:72px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:10px clamp(18px,4vw,64px); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.18); background:rgba(12,13,12,.9); } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-inquiry-shell{clip-path:none;transform:none;transition:none;}}

components.name: Inquiry Pricing and Proposal
components.description: Two-act inquiry: a dark three-column pricing ledger with only the recommended center plan in Acid Signal, followed by a warm-white underline-field proposal sheet.
components.css: .ds-pricing { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); border-block:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2); background:#11110f; color:#f2f1eb; } .ds-pricing article { min-height:520px; padding:clamp(30px,4vw,58px) clamp(22px,3vw,44px); border-right:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2); } .ds-pricing .is-recommended { background:#d9f45f; color:#11110f; } .ds-proposal { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.72fr 1.28fr; min-height:100dvh; padding:clamp(120px,16vh,180px) clamp(22px,6vw,96px); background:#f2f1eb; color:#11110f; } .ds-proposal input,.ds-proposal select,.ds-proposal textarea { width:100%; min-height:54px; padding:10px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(17,17,15,.38); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#11110f; } @media(max-width:720px){.ds-pricing,.ds-proposal form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-pricing article{min-height:0;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(242,241,235,.2)}.ds-proposal{display:block;}}

narrative.overview: NeoRealm LAB treats the selected site as an authored cinematic field. Graphite surfaces, Projection White type, one Acid Signal, a three-plane salon gallery, a low-chroma Instagram rail, and clipped pointer trails prove current web, AI visual, and motion capability before a supporting legacy archive appears.
keyCharacteristics: Direction B is selected; Direction A remains comparison apparatus only.
Marcellus carries English display, navigation, and labels; Zen Old Mincho carries Chinese and body reading.
The supplied SVG wordmark anchors the navigation.
The 178dvh KV uses the supplied video and a clean loading poster.
Studio synchronizes three generated abstract images with three scrolling chapters.
Three asymmetric work planes preserve twelve full 4:5 canvases while bounded scale, vertical and lateral parallax create depth; a twenty-image low-chroma Instagram rail restores color on approach.
Mobile and reduced-motion modes remove nonessential transforms and video playback.
Project inquiry moves from a dark editorial pricing ledger to an inverted warm-white proposal sheet inside a full-viewport native dialog.
The live interface demonstrates current web skill without exposing internal strategy; legacy work is supporting provenance.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Projection White and graphite neutrals carry most screens so Acid Signal remains rare enough to direct attention.

rules.name: The Marcellus Frame Rule
rules.body: Use Marcellus for English, display, navigation, labels, and release naming.

rules.name: The Zen Reading Rule
rules.body: Use Zen Old Mincho for Chinese and body reading.

rules.name: The Two-Message KV Rule
rules.body: The primary copy exits before the reveal copy enters during ordinary motion.

rules.name: The Sticky Counterpoint Rule
rules.body: Studio holds one visual field while three text chapters advance.

rules.name: The Perspective Salon Rule
rules.body: Selected work changes scale, speed, and lateral position by plane and never returns to equal card columns.

rules.name: The Full-Frame Plate Rule
rules.body: Preserve the supplied 4:5 post canvas with contain fitting; never crop artwork to manufacture depth.

rules.name: The Color-on-Approach Rule
rules.body: The Instagram field stays low-chroma until pointer hover or keyboard focus restores original color.

rules.name: The Bounded Trail Rule
rules.body: Fine-pointer media response uses clipped displacement bands and never becomes free dragging or reordering.

rules.name: The Motion-Off Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion pauses video and removes parallax, card drift, and ghost layers.

rules.name: The Sharp System Rule
rules.body: Production geometry stays rectangular; prototype pills do not enter the product identity.

rules.name: The Two-Act Inquiry Rule
rules.body: Qualify with a dark pricing ledger, then invert to a warm-white proposal sheet; do not collapse the sequence into rounded cards.

rules.name: The Recommended-Only Signal Rule
rules.body: Within pricing, Acid Signal belongs only to the recommended center plan.

dos: Do use Marcellus for English, display, navigation, labels, and release titles.
Do use Zen Old Mincho for Chinese and body reading.
Do preserve the supplied SVG wordmark and white-on-black navigation treatment.
Do preserve the two-message 178dvh KV and its user-provided video/poster relationship.
Do keep Studio as a 50/50 sticky-image narrative with three scrolling steps.
Do let the current interface prove web capability without narrating internal strategy.
Do keep waterfall interaction bounded to fine-pointer desktop.
Do use the native dialog top layer and restore focus to the exact inquiry opener after every close path.
Do stack pricing and collapse the proposal form to one column at 720px and below.
Do report form loading, success, and recoverable error copy through a restrained polite live region.
Do fully remove video playback and transforms for reduced motion.
donts: Don't use DIN Condensed, Avenir Next, or a generic sans-serif as the selected identity.
Don't expose the QR intro from the supplied video as the KV first frame.
Don't make both KV messages compete during ordinary motion.
Don't turn Studio into a carousel or uniform card grid.
Don't allow release cards to reorder or move without bounds.
Don't enable pointer effects on mobile.
Don't present every pricing plan in Acid Signal or turn the ledger into floating rounded cards.
Don't wrap proposal fields in cards; keep the warm-white sheet and underline-only controls.
Don't let legacy cases outrank the current experience.
Don't add glow, glossy glass cards, dashboard styling, or cursor tricks outside the media trails.
